title: Pillar III — TensorLUT
youtubeTitle: HELUT Pillar III: TensorLUT — Differentiable Hardware Cryptanalysis
description: TensorLUT turns Yosys LUT6 INIT tables into continuous tensors, evaluates them on Metal, and emits discrete Verilog when λ freezes the elite. Melt-freeze-snap C44; 2-LUT cascade emit C48. Parallel research to the P1030680 campaign — not a decrypt claim. Epoch C51.

scenes.headline: TensorLUT
scenes.subhead: When the look-up tables themselves become the genotype.
scenes.voiceover: Pillar three is TensorLUT. Instead of fixing the circuit and searching keys, we let the INIT tables of Yosys LUT6 cells become continuous tensors — and search the silicon genotype on Metal.

scenes.headline: 64-wide floats · multilinear kernel
scenes.subhead: Inject → forward → clock → sample, with a rising λ toward binary.
scenes.voiceover: Yosys LUT6 cells become 64-wide floating-point INIT tensors. Metal evaluates them with a multilinear kernel and ticks flip-flops in a streaming contract: inject, forward, clock, sample. Soft ciphertext-times-plaintext mean-square error is the fitness. A rising lambda penalty squeezes fractions toward binary. When the elite snaps clean, an emitter writes gate-level Verilog with frozen INIT literals.

scenes.headline: What the laboratory proved
bullets: M4 TensorLUT baseline locks at F-crypto equals zero
Full INIT melt and stecker-cone melt shattered under λ
Involution sandwich: freeze core, evolve ≤10-pair stecker
scenes.voiceover: The laboratory grades are public. A TensorLUT baseline on Enigma M4 locks the unmutated netlist at crypto fitness zero. Full INIT melt and stecker-cone melt shattered under lambda — diagnosed dead ends. The live arm freezes the known-good TensorLUT core and evolves a stecker involution of at most ten pairs, sandwiched around that frozen silicon. Blind three-pair rediscovery on a short crib already passed. That is structural reciprocity — not a free-form plugboard fantasy.

scenes.headline: Continuous → discrete Theorem 1
scenes.subhead: Six lemmas plus melt-freeze-snap on a 1-LUT interpolant (C44).
scenes.voiceover: TensorLUT is not only a melt trick. A formal certificate packs six lemmas — projection, mean-square error, fitness, emitter, involution, and freeze — so continuous search can graduate back to discrete hardware without hand-waving. Claim C44 is melt-freeze-snap for a fully observed look-up table. Claim C48 is a two-LUT cascade: AND into XOR, melted from one-half, snapped, emitted as Verilog, matching all eight Boolean corners — even when the elite finds a dual interpolant like NAND plus XNOR. That is still not completeness for arbitrary netlists. The theorem lives beside the code; the test filter is the receipt.

scenes.headline: Parallel to the campaign — not a crib
bullets: Not a substitute for catalog ring coverage
Evidence room grades shatter and involution separately
scenes.voiceover: TensorLUT is parallel research. It is not a Thetis crib and it is not a claim that U-534 message P1030680 is broken. Catalog ring coverage and Welchman negatives stay on their own ledger. Differentiable hardware is a method for auditing genotypes — not a shortcut past clean negatives.

scenes.headline: Keep the claim sheet honest
scenes.subhead: Reproduce commands · living textbook · open hedges printed.
scenes.voiceover: That is the three-pillar intro. Cleartext Metal for campaign search. Torus FHE for encrypted ticks with certificates. TensorLUT for differentiable hardware. Everything public is reproducible. Everything open stays printed. Start at helut.digitaldefiance.org — and read the claim sheet before you trust a sentence.
